QuestInfo.name: Sakura's Request
QuestInfo.0: #bSakura#k has been crying in front of the Showa Town police station. You should see what's wrong.
QuestInfo.1: #bSakura#k asked you to find the #bBoss Kitty#k that stole her Orange Marble, and return the marble to her.
QuestInfo.2: You promised to get #bSakura#k's orange marble back. There's no choice now but to confront the thief.

0.0: My daddy works in the city, so he's not home very often. Every time he comes home, he brings me something nice, but my most favorite treasure was a beautiful Orange Marble. But... it was stolen, by some stupid cat! I don't know what to do. Waaaahhhh! Could you please help me get my marble back?

yes.0: Thank you soooo much! I'm counting on you!

no.0: I'm sorry to ask so much of you. *Sniff* I'm sure you're busy. If you get some free time could you please help me?
